review_description: Southside Solar and Electrical were very prompt in attending my property and quickly assessed the situation regarding a mix of single and three phase power supply. Calvin was very clear with what the situation was and how the installation would need to happen. He sent a quote within 48hours and was very approachable when explanations were sought. On acceptance of the quote the necessary approvals etc were actioned and were quickly responded to. Installation was completed on the day booked and was very professionally done. System well explained and Western Power notified so that side of work could be booked. Since system has been ‘live’ everything has proceeded as expected. Could not fault experience.
